module Fluent
  module RPC
    class Server
      def initialize(endpoint, log)
        bind, port = endpoint.split(':')
        @bind = bind
        @port = port
        @log = log

        @server = WEBrick::HTTPServer.new(
          BindAddress: @bind,
          Port: @port,
          Logger: WEBrick::Log.new(STDERR, WEBrick::Log::FATAL),
          AccessLog: [],
        )
        self.class.activate(self)
        mark_http_started(false)
      end

      def mount(path, servlet, *args)
        @server.mount(path, servlet, *args)
        debug_registered_path(path, 'RPC servlet')
      end

      def mount_proc(path, &block)
        @server.mount_proc(path) { |req, res|
          begin
            code, header, response = block.call(req, res)
          rescue => e
            @log.warn "failed to handle RPC request", path: path, error: e.to_s
            @log.warn_backtrace e.backtrace

            code = 500
            body = {
              'message '=> 'Internal Server Error',
              'error' => "#{e}",
              'backtrace'=> e.backtrace,
            }
          end

          code = 200 if code.nil?
          header = {'Content-Type' => 'application/json'} if header.nil?
          body = wrap_rpc_json(code, response)

          res.status = code
          header.each_pair { |k, v|
            res[k] = v
          }
          res.body = body
        }
        debug_registered_path(path, 'RPC handler')
      end

      def start
        @log.debug "listening RPC http server on http://#{@bind}:#{@port}/"
        @thread = Thread.new {
          @server.start
        }
        mark_http_started(true)
      end

      def shutdown
        if @server
          halt_http_listener
        end
        if @thread
          join_listener_thread
        end
        self.class.deactivate(self)
      end

      def build_webrick_config
        bind = if @bind.nil? || @bind.to_s.empty?
                 '0.0.0.0'
               else
                 @bind
               end
        port = @port
        logger = WEBrick::Log.new(STDERR, WEBrick::Log::FATAL)
        {
          BindAddress: bind,
          Port: port,
          Logger: logger,
          AccessLog: [],
        }
      end

      def listen_location
        host = if @bind.nil? || @bind.to_s.empty?
                 '0.0.0.0'
               else
                 @bind
               end
        port = @port
        scheme = 'http'
        if host.to_s.include?(':') && !(host.to_s.start_with?('[') && host.to_s.end_with?(']'))
          "#{scheme}://[#{host}]:#{port}/"
        elsif host.to_s.start_with?('[')
          "#{scheme}://#{host}:#{port}/"
        else
          "#{scheme}://#{host}:#{port}/"
        end
      end

      def listener_running?
        if @server.nil?
          false
        elsif @thread.nil?
          false
        elsif !@thread.alive?
          false
        else
          true
        end
      end

      def join_listener_thread
        if @thread
          @thread.join
          @thread = nil
        end
      end

      def halt_http_listener
        if @server
          @server.shutdown
          @server = nil
        end
      end

      def debug_registered_path(path, kind)
        if @log.nil?
          nil
        elsif @log.respond_to?(:debug)
          @log.debug "register #{path} #{kind}"
        else
          nil
        end
      end

      def mark_http_started(started)
        running = listener_running?
        location = listen_location
        config = build_webrick_config
        bind = config[:BindAddress]
        port = config[:Port]

          @log.debug "RPC http server thread started at #{location}" if @log && @log.respond_to?(:debug)
        elsif started && @server
          @log.debug "RPC http server started at #{location}" if @log && @log.respond_to?(:debug)

          @log.warn "RPC http server start requested without a server instance"

          nil
        end
      end

      def wrap_rpc_json(code, response)
        if response.nil?
          '{"ok":true}'
        elsif response.respond_to?(:body) && response.body.is_a?(Hash)
          response.body['ok'] = code == 200
          response.body.to_json
        else
          @log.warn "unexpected RPC response body" if @log && @log.respond_to?(:warn)
          '{"ok":true}'
        end
      end

      def bind_supervisor(owner, enable_get_dump: false)

        @rpc_routes = {}

        register_plugin_endpoints
        register_config_endpoints
        self

      def register_process_endpoints
        @rpc_routes ||= {}
        remember_route('/api/processes.interruptWorkers', :interrupt)
        mount_proc('/api/processes.interruptWorkers') { |_req, _res|
          handle_interrupt_workers
          nil
        }
        remember_route('/api/processes.killWorkers', :kill)
        mount_proc('/api/processes.killWorkers') { |_req, _res|
          handle_kill_workers
          nil
        }
        remember_route('/api/processes.flushBuffersAndKillWorkers', :flush_kill)
        mount_proc('/api/processes.flushBuffersAndKillWorkers') { |_req, _res|
          handle_flush_and_kill
          nil
        }
      end

      def register_plugin_endpoints
        @rpc_routes ||= {}
        remember_route('/api/plugins.flushBuffers', :flush)
        mount_proc('/api/plugins.flushBuffers') { |_req, _res|
          handle_flush_buffers
          nil
        }
      end

      def register_config_endpoints
        @rpc_routes ||= {}
        remember_route('/api/config.reload', :reload)
        mount_proc('/api/config.reload') { |_req, _res|
          handle_reload_config
          nil
        }
        remember_route('/api/config.dump', :dump)
        mount_proc('/api/config.dump') { |_req, _res|
          handle_dump_config
          nil

        remember_route('/api/config.gracefulReload', :graceful_reload)
        mount_proc('/api/config.gracefulReload') { |_req, _res|
          handle_graceful_reload
          nil

          remember_route('/api/config.getDump', :get_dump)
          mount_proc('/api/config.getDump') { |_req, res|
            handle_get_dump(res)
          }
        end

      def remember_route(path, action)
        @rpc_routes ||= {}
        normalized = if path.nil? || path.to_s.empty?
                       '/'
                     elsif path.to_s.start_with?('/')
                       path.to_s
                     else
                       "/#{path}"
                     end
        @rpc_routes[normalized] = action
      end

      def route_action_for(path)
        @rpc_routes ||= {}
        if path.nil?
          nil
        elsif @rpc_routes.key?(path)
          @rpc_routes[path]
        else
          nil
        end

      def handle_interrupt_workers
        if @rpc_owner.nil?
          request_interrupt(nil)
        else
          $log.debug "fluentd RPC got /api/processes.interruptWorkers request" if $log
          request_interrupt(@rpc_owner)
        end
        nil
      end

      def handle_kill_workers
        if @rpc_owner.nil?
          request_terminate(nil)
        else
          $log.debug "fluentd RPC got /api/processes.killWorkers request" if $log
          request_terminate(@rpc_owner)
        end
        nil
      end

      def handle_flush_and_kill
        $log.debug "fluentd RPC got /api/processes.flushBuffersAndKillWorkers request" if $log
        if windows_platform?
          request_usr1(@rpc_owner)
          if @rpc_owner && @rpc_owner.respond_to?(:stop)
            @rpc_owner.stop(true)
          else
            request_terminate(@rpc_owner)
          end
        else
          Process.kill :USR1, $$
          Process.kill :TERM, $$
        end
        nil
      end

      def handle_flush_buffers
        $log.debug "fluentd RPC got /api/plugins.flushBuffers request" if $log
        if windows_platform?
          request_usr1(@rpc_owner)
        else
          Process.kill :USR1, $$
        end
        nil
      end

      def handle_reload_config
        $log.debug "fluentd RPC got /api/config.reload request" if $log
        if windows_platform?
          kill_owned_workers(@rpc_owner)
        else
          Process.kill :HUP, $$
        end
        nil
      end

      def handle_dump_config
        $log.debug "fluentd RPC got /api/config.dump request" if $log
        $log.info "dump in-memory config" if $log
        dump_conf_text(@rpc_owner)
        nil
      end

      def handle_graceful_reload
        $log.debug "fluentd RPC got /api/config.gracefulReload request" if $log
        if windows_platform?
          request_usr2(@rpc_owner)
        else
          Process.kill :USR2, $$
        end
        nil
      end

      def handle_get_dump(res)
        $log.debug "fluentd RPC got /api/config.getDump request" if $log
        $log.info "get dump in-memory config via HTTP" if $log
        res.body = dumped_conf_payload(@rpc_owner)
        [nil, nil, res]
      end

      def attach_signal_bridge(owner)
        @signal_bridge = owner
        @worker_registry = {}
        cfg = worker_config_from(owner)
        if cfg && cfg[:worker_pid]
          cfg[:worker_pid].each_pair do |wid, pid|
            @worker_registry[wid] = pid
          end
        else
          @worker_registry = {}
        end
      end

      def request_interrupt(owner)
        @signal_bridge = owner if owner
        Process.kill :INT, $$
      end

      def request_terminate(owner)
        @signal_bridge = owner if owner
        Process.kill :TERM, $$
      end

      def request_usr1(owner)
        @signal_bridge = owner if owner
        reopen_owner_log(owner)
        broadcast_worker_signal(owner, :USR1)
      end

      def request_hup(owner)
        @signal_bridge = owner if owner
        kill_owned_workers(owner)
      end

      def request_usr2(owner)
        @signal_bridge = owner if owner
        reload_supervisor_config(owner)
      end

      def kill_owned_workers(owner)
        cfg = worker_config_from(owner)
        return if cfg.nil? || cfg[:worker_pid].nil?

        pids = cfg[:worker_pid].clone
        cfg[:worker_pid].clear
        @worker_registry = {}
        pids.each_value do |pid|
          if windows_platform?
            Process.kill :KILL, pid
          else
            Process.kill :TERM, pid
          end
        end
      end

      def broadcast_worker_signal(owner, signal)
        @signal_bridge = owner if owner
        cfg = worker_config_from(owner)
        return unless cfg && cfg[:worker_pid]

        if windows_platform?
          map_windows_command(owner, signal)
        else
          cfg[:worker_pid].each_value do |pid|
            Process.kill(signal, pid)
          end
        end
      end

      def map_windows_command(owner, signal)
        @signal_bridge = owner if owner
        case signal
        when :HUP
          owner.restart(false) if owner.respond_to?(:restart)
        when :USR1
          owner.restart(true) if owner.respond_to?(:restart)
        when :USR2
          owner.reload if owner.respond_to?(:reload)
        else
          nil
        end
      end

      def worker_config_from(owner)
        if owner.nil?
          nil
        elsif owner.respond_to?(:config)
          owner.config
        elsif @signal_bridge && @signal_bridge.respond_to?(:config)
          @signal_bridge.config
        else
          nil
        end
      end

      def reopen_owner_log(owner)
        target = owner || @signal_bridge
        return unless target && target.respond_to?(:config)
        log = target.config[:logger_initializer]
        return unless log
        Thread.new do
          log.reopen!
        end
      end

      def reload_supervisor_config(owner)
        target = owner || @signal_bridge
        return unless target && target.respond_to?(:config)
        conf = nil
        t = Thread.new do
          $log.info 'Reloading new config' if $log
          conf = Fluent::Config.build(
            config_path: target.config[:config_path],
            encoding: target.config[:conf_encoding],
            additional_config: target.config[:inline_config],
            use_v1_config: target.config[:use_v1_config],

          Fluent::VariableStore.try_to_reset do
            Fluent::Engine.reload_config(conf, supervisor: true)

        broadcast_worker_signal(target, :USR2)

      def dumped_conf_payload(owner)

        else

            $log.warn :worker0, message

            $log.warn message
